Alice Huang, the woman at the center of the Nvidia scandal, has extensive indirect ties to China’s defense industry and military-linked companies. An intelligence investigation found that about $3.6 billion in Chinese government funding flowed through companies associated with her family and business partners, supporting projects involving Nvidia chips. The network connects Nvidia partners to Chinese military contractors involved in missile systems, military aircraft and electronics. U.S. officials are investigating whether restricted Nvidia chips reached China and were used for military purposes, though no such use has been established. Source: NYT

Remembering Sayyedah Fatimah al-Zahra: Two Essential Dimensions of Faith and Righteousness By Sayyed Muhammad Baqir al-Sistani There are two valuable dimensions that ought to be brought to mind when commemorating the martyrdom of the Sayyedah Fatimah al-Zahra (peace be upon her). The first dimension is the completion of faith through belief in the divine selection and special status of the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), and the preservation of this faith in the face of doubts and misconceptions, both individually and socially, so as to convey this dimension of the final Divine Message. The second dimension is paying attention to the completion of one’s faith in Allah, the Exalted, through all other avenues of faith and righteous action. Allah, the Exalted, has emphasized in the Holy Qur’an that salvation and success are contingent upon faith in Allah and righteous deeds. He says: “And those who believe and do righteous deeds—those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.” (Qur’an 2:82) As for those who have mixed righteous deeds with others that are sinful, they remain in danger. The meaning of righteous action is sustained obedience to Allah, the Exalted, such that sin has no place in one’s life; and if one does fall into sin, one must repent of it with sincere repentance. Among the minimum levels of salvation that provide assurance of entering Paradise is that a person should be among those who believe and perform righteous deeds. Although faith in Allah and righteous action are two distinct elements, they appear to interact with one another. The stronger and more firmly rooted one’s faith is, the more conducive it is to righteous action, and the more it instills awe, reverence, and fear of Allah, the Exalted. In the life of our Sayyedah al-Zahra (peace be upon her), we find a profound experience of worship—something from which many people are deprived. Whoever loses the spirit of worship loses the spirit of life itself. She (peace be upon her) was an exalted example in devotion to Allah and obedience to Him. Worshipping Allah, the Exalted, is a feeling of spiritual elevation, the satisfaction of the conscience, the fulfillment of gratitude, and a perpetual sense of need for Allah. This is the true spirit of life. We need to reflect upon creation with fairness, compassion, and concern; to pray for others as we pray for ourselves and our families. Whoever feels the suffering of others, Allah, the Exalted, will esteem and elevate them. Sayyedah Fatimah al-Zahra (peace be upon her) lived her entire life marked by asceticism, not out of deprivation, but by deliberately turning away from the manifestations of luxury and preferring others over her noble self. She spent what came to her from the land of Fadak on the poor, and she would pray for the neighbor before praying for the house. 🌪️ A hailstorm battered the city of Tupanciretá, in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, for 40 minutes in the early morning hours of Friday, November 20, leaving at least three dead, 60 injured, and 5,000 homes damaged, according to Civil Defense, while authorities investigate the possibility of a tornado. 🏥 The storm destroyed the central square, City Hall, and the only local hospital, forcing the injured and patients to be transferred to neighboring municipalities due to a complete outage of electricity, water, and telephone service. 🌎 Governor Eduardo Leite mobilized emergency teams in a region battered by weeks of storms linked to El Niño, a phenomenon that is also exacerbating the drought in the Amazon.

Trump’s envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met senior Qatari officials in Berlin on Thursday to discuss efforts to revive U.S.-Iran negotiations. Qatar is seeking to restore the ceasefire, restart nuclear talks and prevent renewed fighting. Trump said he would not decide on further military action against Iran until the new year, despite pressure from Netanyahu. Iranian and Qatari officials have held several meetings in recent weeks, but no significant progress has been made. Source: Axios

🇺🇸 US Weighs NATO for Ukraine in Exchange for Donbass Wall Street Journal reports US negotiators are discussing a scenario where Kiev cedes remaining Donbass territories controlled by the AFU in exchange for NATO membership. An alternative involves freezing the conflict along the current front line with security guarantees from Washington and European allies. Moscow insists on Ukraine's non-accession to the alliance. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz reportedly told aides that Ukraine will not join NATO during his lifetime, highlighting divisions within Europe. Context: Zelensky demands US bases and Article 5 commitments as guarantees. Meanwhile, Merz confirmed Germany is prepared to fund the war throughout 2027 if necessary. EU Commission President von der Leyen stated nearly €8 billion is being paid to Ukraine. @Slavyangrad
